answer.summary: Docker build fails at mvn install in the api-builder stage because the Renovate bump to elasticsearch.version cannot resolve co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java:jar:8.19.25 from central, shibboleth, or jboss. The version is likely unpublished or wrong, so a rerun should fail the same way. Confidence is moderate because the log shows only 'Could not find' and not whether the version exists, so a transient mirror gap is possible.

evidence.quote: [ERROR] Failed to execute goal on project openaev-es8-client: Could not resolve dependencies for project io.openaev:openaev-es8-client:jar:3.261110.0
[ERROR] 	Could not find artifact co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java:jar:8.19.25 in central (https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2)
#30 ERROR: process "/bin/sh -c mvn install -DskipTests -Pdev" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
